adoption_gate: Promote only when held-out retrieval quality improves enough to justify index size, latency, memory, provider cost, and operational complexity.
notes: BGE-M3 is shortlisted for multilingual, long-context, dense/sparse/multi-vector capability; this experiment isolates its dense representation.
OpenAI text-embedding-3-large is shortlisted as the current most-capable hosted OpenAI embedding model and shortened to 1024 dimensions for a like-sized hosted comparison.
A missing hosted credential is recorded as credential_required rather than silently substituting a model or fabricating a result.
